method: Offline inspection of the same Kokoro tokenizer phoneme output used for narration; not subjective listening
text: Overexpression means producing more of a gene's product than usual. These results support a role for ARF1 in adjusting root growth, but the numbers belong to the particular experiment. They are not universal values for rice fields. The researchers also combined changes in ARF1 and CESA6. These combined genetic tests supported the idea that ARF1 affects the response partly through the cellulose-producing machinery.

observation: The tokenizer contains the spoken acronym CESA followed by six. It does not insert an extra letter S. Scientific convention was not independently established by this check.
